_schema: Investor-relations report sources, keyed by ticker. Only status "live" entries are fetched automatically. "manual_import" entries are filed by the owner through the manual-import path. Every other status is a TODO. Each entry has its fiscal year-end (fye, MM-DD); the fiscal label is derived from the stated period-end date, never from the calendar year alone. The fetcher uses the company's own domains only (allowed_hosts), obeys robots.txt for each host, and writes PDFs to the document vault (never Git, never a database). See engines/ir_fetcher.py and engines/fiscal_period.py.
_verified_on: 2026-11-12 (one plain GET per host plus robots.txt; see the notes on each entry)

OGDC.name: Oil and Gas Development Company Limited
OGDC.notes: The reports page is protected by a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403 seen earlier on the investor-relations page). The challenge is not bypassed. Reports are filed through the manual-import path.
